name: delta-a
prompt: Using the reference image ONLY for its polished chrome material, crisp specular highlights, dark reflections, soft rounded chunky modelling and exact top-down symmetric view: create a different aircraft, a supersonic delta-wing jet. Strict orthographic view from directly above, nose pointing STRAIGHT UP, perfectly mirror-symmetric. Shape of our own: a long slim fuselage with a long pointed but softly rounded needle nose, a large smooth ogee delta wing that starts at mid fuselage and sweeps back to wide rounded wingtips at the rear, a slim tail, no horizontal tailplane, two small round exhaust nozzles at the rear. Below the nozzles, two short tapering afterburner flames point straight down: white-hot core, warm yellow then coral orange, fading smoothly to fully transparent. The aircraft fills about 70 percent of the frame height in the upper part, the flames below. Fully transparent background, no shadow.

name: delta-b
prompt: Using the reference only for material and rendering style (mirror-polished chrome, crisp highlights, deep reflections, plump rounded toy-like volumes, top-down orthographic view): a chunky stylised supersonic jet with a smooth double-delta wing, viewed exactly from above, nose straight up, perfectly symmetric left and right. Slender fuselage with a softly rounded drooping needle nose, wings blending smoothly into the body with rounded tips, two rounded engine nacelles side by side under the rear of the wing, no tailplane. No flames. Centred, filling about 80 percent of the frame height. Fully transparent background, no shadow.
